data_status: STRICT MODE: this dataset contains only values that were compared with, or ingested directly from, retrieved sources: JPL (SSD, SBDB), NASA (NSSDC fact sheets and mission catalog, Small Spacecraft SoA report 2026, SLS page, Apollo 11 press kit, NTRS papers, ), ULA, ESA, NIST, and the Launch Library 2 aggregator. Records carry source_authority/confidence where the source is an aggregator or vendor-reported compilation. Recalled, estimated and fictional values (optimizer catalog, costs, engine/vehicle specs without a retrievable source, the user-supplied SpaceX table) are not included. Derived values are computed only from verified inputs and are labelled derived.

published.atmospheric_composition: Sodium 12,000-200,000; Magnesium 100,000; Oxygen <40,000; Hydrogen 5000, Potassium 800-1300, Calcium 300-1000; Iron <300; Aluminum 15; and possible trace amounts of Argon (Ar), Carbon Dioxide (CO 2 ), Water (H 2 O), Nitrogen (N 2 ), Xenon (Xe), Krypton (Kr), Neon (Ne), Helium (He) (The atmosphere of Mercury is a surface bounded exosphere, essentially a vacuum. Values for some species can vary with local time or location, these are given as ranges.) Notes on the factsheets - definitions of parameters, units, notes on sub- and superscripts, etc. Planetary Fact Table - metric units Planetary Fact

record.parse_note: 'published' holds the text exactly as printed on the NASA NSSDC fact sheet; 'parsed' holds the first number and unit of selected fields (check units: bars, mb, kPa, K).
